name: What is involved in preparing walls for interior painting?

mainEntity.name: What is involved in preparing walls for interior painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Proper wall preparation is crucial for a durable and professional-looking paint finish. This process typically includes cleaning the walls to remove dirt, grease, and grime, repairing any cracks or holes with spackle or joint compound, and sanding smooth rough patches. Taping off trim, windows, and ceilings is done to ensure clean lines. Priming may also be necessary, especially for new drywall, stained surfaces, or when changing to a significantly different color. Adequate preparation ensures paint adheres correctly and lasts longer.
acceptedAnswer.description: Wall preparation involves cleaning, repairing cracks and holes, sanding, and taping off areas. Priming may also be necessary for certain surfaces.
